name: RAND Corporation (Arlington office)
address: 1200 South Hayes Street, Arlington, VA 22202-5050

RAND is a federal contractor operating FFRDCs. No formal undergraduate program found; the RAND careers page itself lists no openings (dynamic).

name: Brookings Institution

name: Carnegie Endowment for International Peace

name: Center for Strategic and International Studies (CSIS)
address: 1616 Rhode Island Avenue NW, Washington, DC 20036

name: The Heritage Foundation
address: 214 Massachusetts Avenue NE, Washington, DC 20002
entry_roles: Research Associate (e.g., Allison Center for National Security)

Internship Program is for college students; program pages not individually opened, so program URLs point to the careers hub. No clearance mentioned. heritage.org blocks plain curl (403) but loads via fetch tool.

name: Urban Institute

notes: Opened RA posting requires a bachelor's (or associate's with equivalent experience), preferably public policy or related. Applications run through urban.wd115.myworkdayjobs.com/Urban-Careers. Role fit 4 because research is quantitative domestic policy. No clearance.
